title: Hide a category in a view with a rule-based filter
task: Create a ParameterFilterElement over a category using a filterable parameter (from ParameterFilterUtilities.GetFilterableParametersInCommon) and switch it off with View.SetFilterVisibility to hide that category in the view. Covers filter-based visibility control.

pitfalls.symptom: ParameterFilterElement.Create throws ArgumentException 'One of the given rules refers to a parameter that does not apply to this filter's categories' (e.g. when using ELEM_FAMILY_AND_TYPE_PARAM).
pitfalls.cause: Not every parameter is filterable for a given category; the rule parameter must be in the category's filterable set.
pitfalls.fix: Choose the rule parameter from ParameterFilterUtilities.GetFilterableParametersInCommon(doc, categories) before building the rule.

pitfalls.symptom: SetFilterVisibility appears to have no effect in the view.
pitfalls.cause: The view's Filters are controlled by its view template, so filter changes on the view itself are ignored.
pitfalls.fix: Use a view with no template, or set the filter visibility inside the view template so every view it controls hides the category.

hit.text: hide a category of elements in a view using a filter visibility toggle
